description: Design beautiful CSS gradients with two color pickers and an angle slider. Preview it live, then copy the ready-to-use linear-gradient CSS.
howto: Drag the angle slider or choose a direction.
Click Copy CSS to paste the gradient into your project.
title: Gradient Generator

faqs.a: The angle sets the direction of the gradient — 0deg goes bottom to top, 90deg goes left to right, and 135deg runs diagonally.

faqs.q: Will the CSS work in all browsers?
faqs.a: Yes. The generated linear-gradient syntax is supported by every modern browser on desktop and mobile.

faqs.q: Can I make a gradient with more than two colors?
faqs.a: This tool makes clean two-color gradients. You can extend the copied CSS yourself by adding more color stops to the linear-gradient() function.
